result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main visual defect is a loading spinner stuck over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, suggesting the image or content failed to finish loading.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image in the 'Popular right now' section, even though the image behind it appears loaded. This suggests a stuck/orphaned loading state that never resolved.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading indicator is removed once the image finishes loading (or on load error, replace it with a fallback image). Add a timeout/error handler so the spinner cannot persist indefinitely.
